headline: Premada Oorali is now streaming on Prime Video: OTT release date and where to watch
dek: The Kannada film, starring Rangayana Raghu, Shri Mahadev, Thapaswini, arrived on Prime Video 46 days after opening in cinemas on 2 October.
paragraphs: Premada Oorali is streaming on Prime Video in India from 17 November.
That is 46 days after its theatrical release on 2 October — 17 days slower than the typical 29 days for Kannada films, based on 45 recent releases tracked by New on OTT.

Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.
Directed by Manoj Kumar, starring Rangayana Raghu, Shri Mahadev, Thapaswini, Ramika Shivu, Ilaa Vitla. The film runs 155 minutes and is certified U/A 16+.
New on OTT re-checks Prime Video's India listing every day; the page for Premada Oorali has the latest on where to watch it.
